test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 05
subject: general
question:
A field roller, in the shape of a cylinder, has a diameter of 1 m and length of 1(1)/(4) m. If the speed at which the roller rolls is 15 revolutions per minute, the maximum area (in m²) that it can roll in 1 hour is:

(Take π = frac{{22}}{7}) (nearest to an integer)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Area = (Revolutions per minute × Minutes) × (π × diameter × length)

⇒ Area = (15 × 60) × (22/7 × 1 × 1.25)

⇒ Area = 900 × (27.5 / 7)

⇒ Area = 24750 / 7 ≈ 3535.71

⇒ Rounding to the nearest integer, we get 3536.

**∴ The correct answer is 3536 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of the roller (d) = 1 m

Length of the roller (h) = 1(1/4) m = 1.25 m

Speed of rolling = 15 revolutions/minute

Time = 1 hour = 60 minutes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea77208e9f540bfe599ab67d5ceb0eeac4707a85dc24975dfdff9041c64f1e06.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = π × d × h

Total Area = Total Revolutions × CSA

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total revolutions in 60 minutes = 15 × 60 = 900

⇒ Area covered in 1 revolution = π × 1 × 1.25

⇒ Area covered in 1 revolution = (22/7) × 1.25 = 27.5 / 7 m²

⇒ Total area rolled in 1 hour = 900 × (27.5 / 7)

⇒ Total area = 24750 / 7 m²

⇒ Total area ≈ 3535.71 m²

⇒ Rounding to the nearest integer, we get 3536 m².

**∴ The correct answer is 3536 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of a Cylinder

The lateral or curved surface area is the area of the sides of the cylinder excluding the circular top and bottom. Formula: CSA = 2πrh or πdh.

Total Surface Area of a Cylinder

It includes the curved surface area plus the area of the two circular bases. Formula: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Concept of Rolling Distance

When a cylindrical roller completes exactly one full revolution, it covers an area on the ground exactly equal to its curved surface area.
